alerts.headline: Iran reports tanker mining in Hormuz; Iranian drones downed over Gulf
alerts.summary: The IRGC said two tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran warned vessels to coordinate passage while its security chief vowed to break the US blockade. Iran's air defence also claims it shot down two US drones over the Persian Gulf.
alerts.turkey: Mining and a contested blockade of Hormuz raise energy prices and shipping risk for Türkiye's imports and tanker traffic, and push Iran toward northern overland trade routes near Türkiye.

alerts.headline: Parliamentary monitoring commission for Terror-Free Türkiye to be formed
alerts.summary: Speaker Kurtulmuş said the 19-member parliamentary monitoring commission will be formed, with lawmakers named by 30 November. Erdoğan called the process a historic opportunity and urged against provocations and political disputes undermining it.
alerts.turkey: Formation of the commission is a concrete next step in the PKK disarmament process, and its composition will shape how the process is monitored domestically.

alerts.summary: Libya's House of Representatives approved the Türkiye-Libya maritime jurisdiction agreement, and it is now published in the Official Gazette with maps and coordinates. This moves the deal from signed to legally operative in Libya.
alerts.turkey: The agreement's legal entry into force strengthens Türkiye's claims in the eastern Mediterranean and its energy and maritime position against Greece and Cyprus.
